name: Lab 2 Calculator (NPV Workflow)
description: Eval for the Lab 2 CalculateWithTools workflow. The agent computes NPV = FV / (1+discount/100)^years using the Calculator Tool (exponent + division calls). Each record has a pre-computed exact expected answer so correctness can be checked numerically with npv_exact_match (no judge LLM required). The canonical case (FV=5000, years=4.5, discount=6.5%) exactly matches the lab Step 7 reference output of $3,766.14.
